Predicates:
YaleUniversity(x) ::: x is Yale University.
Private(x) ::: x is a private institution.
IvyLeague(x) ::: x is an Ivy League university.
ResearchUniversity(x) ::: x is a research university.
MovedTo(x, y) ::: x moved to location y.
EndowmentValue(x, y) ::: the endowment of x is valued at y dollars.
ConstituentCollege(x, y) ::: x is a constituent college or school of y.
ResidentialCollege(x) ::: x is a residential college.
YaleGraduateSchool(x) ::: x is the Yale Graduate School of Arts and Sciences.
ProfessionalSchool(x) ::: x is a professional school.
ListOfColleges(x) ::: x is a listed Yale residential college.
LargestEndowment(x) ::: x has the largest endowment.
Premises:
YaleUniversity(yale) ∧ Private(yale) ∧ IvyLeague(yale) ∧ ResearchUniversity(yale) ::: Yale University is a private Ivy League research university.
MovedTo(yale, newHaven) ∧ Year(movedTo(yale, newHaven), 1716) ::: Yale moved to New Haven in 1716.
EndowmentValue(yale, 42.3e9) ::: Yale’s endowment was valued at $42.3 billion.
ConstituentCollege(yale, benjaminFranklin) ∧ ConstituentCollege(yale, berkeley) ∧ ConstituentCollege(yale, branford) ∧ ConstituentCollege(yale, davenport) ∧ ConstituentCollege(yale, ezraStiles) ∧ ConstituentCollege(yale, graceHopper) ∧ ConstituentCollege(yale, jonathanEdwards) ∧ ConstituentCollege(yale, morse) ∧ ConstituentCollege(yale, pauliMurray) ∧ ConstituentCollege(yale, pierson) ∧ ConstituentCollege(yale, saybrook) ∧ ConstituentCollege(yale, silliman) ∧ ConstituentCollege(yale, timothyDwight) ∧ ConstituentCollege(yale, trumbull) ::: Yale has 27 constituent colleges and schools.
LargestEndowment(yale) ::: Yale University has the largest university endowment of any educational institution.
Conclusion:
LargestEndowment(yale)
